changed.text_as_endorsed: Basement. Any area of a building, including any sunken room or sunken portion of a room, having its floor below ground level on all sides, and any area having a finished floor more than two feet below the adjoining exterior grade on at least three sides.
changed.original_text: Basement. Any area of a building, including any sunken room or sunken portion of a room, having its floor below ground level on all sides.
